name: cdm/observable/event/ObservationIdentifier
description: Defines the parameters needed to uniquely identify a piece of data among the population of all available market data.

determinationMethodology.description: Specifies the method according to which an amount or a date is determined.

informationSource.description: Represents where the market data published and should be observed.

observable.description: Represents the asset or rate to which the observation relates.

observationDate.description: Specifies the date value to use when resolving the market data.
